# Coffee with the Mayor

Sat, Jul 5 2025, 8 - 10am

Add to your calendar

![teal background with coffee cup on the right and coffee beans on bottom left text reading Coffee wit…](https://www.townofmead.org/sites/g/files/vyhlif12701/files/styles/full_node_primary/public/media/boardoftrustees/image/43186/coffee_with_the_mayor.png?itok=qua9LzHG)h the Mayor

Coffee with the Mayor is a regularly occurring event that allows Mead residents to attend and discuss their questions, concerns, and ideas with Mayor Colleen Whitlow. Coffee with the Mayor is hosted on the first Saturday of every month from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. a.m. at **Public Works Facility, 1341 WCR 34.** This event is free; coffee and snacks are provided. Come with questions and join a relaxed open discussion, while receiving updates on what's going on around Town.

[Print](https://www.townofmead.org/print/pdf/node/152701)
